messages:
maddie: quick heads-up — i'm kicking off a small bakeoff this afternoon: AWQ vs GPTQ vs FP8 vs INT8 on llama2-70b-chat. goal is to produce 'Optimize' deployment profiles we can push to the registry. need a quick consensus on naming + compatibility metadata before i publish.

anuj: SG. what consumers should the profile metadata cover? hosted API, dedicated, private onprem? any runtime-specific fallbacks?

maddie: yes to all three. hosted (multi-tenant) should prefer smallest latency/size that meets quality gates, dedicated gets variants that preserve throughput, private should be explicit about HW requirements (A100 vs H100) and driver compatibility. fallback policy ideal: prefer AWQ, fallback -> GPTQ -> FP8 (if configured) -> CPU-quantized shim.

sam: naming idea — keep it human+machine friendly: `optimize://<model>-<quant>-<precision>@v<semver>` e.g. `optimize://llama2-70b-chat-awq-4bit@v1`. include `profile-kind` field (performance|compat|quality).

kevin: +1. also include a `runtimes` list so the router can decide compatibility quickly, something like `runtimes: hosted,dedicated,private:h100` in the manifest. and add `hw-requirement` (min compute capability).

maddie: agreed. also need to surface the quant hyperparams (seed, block-size, per-channel flag) and a hyperparam hash for reproducibility — that must be part of the profile id or metadata. otherwise people will debate which AWQ build was used.

ci-bot: bakeoff-run uploaded — https://ci.internal/redwood/runs/2061234567/results
- metrics: perplexity-diff, rouge, exact-match, latency-p50/p95
- artifacts: quant model tarball, quant-config.txt

anuj: for quality gates, propose: abs(perplexity_delta) <= 0.03 AND rouge-L delta <= 1.5 AND 1-oracle regen rate < 4%. if any gate fails mark profile as `degraded` and include fail-reason tags.

sam: another practical bit — add `compat-versions` listing runtime+kernel versions tested, and `quant-tool-version` (e.g., awq-0.9.2, gptq-fast-1.1). makes rollbacks safer.

kevin: think about identifier collisions: use semver for profiles but also include a short content-hash to guarantee immutability, e.g. `@v1+sha256:abcdef`. human-friendly name + immutable suffix.

maddie: perfect. i'll draft a minimal manifest example and push to a branch. quick sketch i'll follow in the PR: 
```
name: optimize://llama2-70b-chat-awq-4bit@v1+sha256:ff12ab
kind: performance
model: llama2-70b-chat
quant: awq
precision: 4bit
runtimes: hosted,dedicated
hw: h100-a100
hyperparams_hash: ff12ab
quality_gates:
  perplexity_delta_max: 0.03
  rouge_l_delta_max: 1.5
  regen_oracle_max_percent: 4
artifacts: gs://redwood-optimize/awq/llama2-70b-chat/v1/ff12ab.tar.gz
```

maddie: i'll ping when the PR is up. want at least one runtime person to sign off before i flip the registry to include this profile. :rocket:

anuj: will review — also can we add a tiny sample eval promptset path and seed used? helps QA reproduce quickly.

sam: also reminder — include a `fallback_policy` field so the router can auto-select next-best variant during outages. simple list: `[awq,gptq,fp8]`.

maddie: noted. thanks everyone — aiming to publish the initial profileset tomorrow morning and trigger a canary on dedicated.
